extends: R1-002 RBAC FROZEN 1.0.0; no prior artifact is edited

permissions.catalog.references.read: Read active staff catalog brands, categories and attribute definitions.
permissions.catalog.products.read: Read internal product roots, editor revisions and publication history; not file bytes or inaccessible file metadata.
permissions.catalog.products.write: Create products and append new DRAFT revisions; never submit or publish implicitly.
permissions.catalog.products.submit: Submit the current DRAFT revision for a human publication decision.
permissions.catalog.products.publish: Publish, return for changes or reject one pending revision; separate from edit and submit.
permissions.catalog.products.archive: Archive one product and suppress its public pointer; preserve all revision history.
permissions.catalog.categories.write: Create/edit/reparent/archive categories under tree and reference integrity rules.
permissions.catalog.brands.write: Create/edit/archive brands under reference integrity rules.
permissions.catalog.attributes.write: Create/edit/archive category-specific typed attribute definitions under semantic immutability rules.
permissions.catalog.products.relations.write: Replace a product draft's manually selected accessory/compatible relations.
permissions.catalog.products.media.write: Replace draft media metadata referencing an already existing accessible FileVersion; no upload/download.
permissions.catalog.products.documents.write: Replace draft document metadata referencing an already existing accessible FileVersion; no upload/download.

mediaOrDocumentsWrite: object-level FileVersion policy from frozen R1-002
mediaOrDocumentsRead: object-level FileVersion policy from frozen R1-002

roleTemplates.bootstrap-admin: No catalog permissions are added automatically.
roleTemplates.access-admin: No catalog permissions are added automatically.
roleTemplates.seller-maintainer: No catalog permissions are added automatically.
roleTemplates.audit-reader: No catalog permissions are added automatically.

rules: Effective permissions remain the ACTIVE-role union of one ACTIVE employee; role names have no authority.
No public/staff route uses catalog.admin, wildcard permissions, UI visibility or role-name checks.
All catalog permissions have default deny. Permission registry migration inserts codes only; no RolePermission grant is seeded.
Staff RBAC grant ceiling remains exactly R1-002: an ordinary permission/assignment change can grant only actions in the actor current effective union.

The one-time operator initialization command is explicit owner-authorized bootstrap, not an HTTP/API path, app startup action, migration side effect or repeatable bypass. It creates a new ordinary role, assigns the complete catalog permission set to that role and one explicitly selected eligible employee, and writes one OPERATOR audit event in the same transaction.

Initialization target is ACTIVE, passwordChangeRequired=false, valid Argon2id credentials, and already has effective staff.roles.read, staff.roles.write, staff.roles.permissions.write and staff.roles.assign. No existing role is altered or auto-expanded.

The one-time command serializes under the existing pg_advisory_xact_lock(1398031445, 2); it verifies the R1-002 control-admin and full-admin invariants before and after, and refuses if either is already broken. Those protected 12 permissions remain unchanged.

A successful catalog-permission initialization action in append-only AuditEvent makes a second initialization fail. Normal delegation after initialization uses ordinary R1-002 RBAC API and grant ceiling.
File metadata calls require both the catalog permission and frozen files.metadata.read/object policy. The catalog FK never grants file visibility or download authority.

initialGrant.role: Creates a normal role with generated non-authoritative code catalog-bootstrap-<request-uuid> and descriptive name; assigns exactly the 12 catalogPermissionCodes listed in this 0.1.0-proposed contract and assigns the role to exactly the selected staff user. The CLI fails closed if the registered R1-004 permission set differs in either direction; changing the pinned set requires an approved contract update.
initialGrant.actor: OPERATOR; operator label and owner approval reference attest an off-application owner decision and are not cryptographic identity proof.
initialGrant.ownerApprovalReference: Required external ticket/reference label, 1..80 characters matching ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{0,79}$. Must not contain secrets or personal data. The CLI records the label only; it does not resolve or prove the approval.
initialGrant.oneTime: At most one successful initialization per database; enforced by advisory lock and append-only catalog.permissions.initialized success audit record.
initialGrant.transaction: Same existing RBAC advisory lock and one PostgreSQL transaction for eligible-target revalidation, role creation, RolePermission rows, UserRole row, last-admin checks and SUCCESS audit; any failure rolls all back.
initialGrant.secretPolicy: No password, file path, token, or credential is accepted by the command. Command is not run by R1-004A or automatically by migration/deployment.
